error: A word is read from the picture or its first letter, not from its letters.
shows: Decoding is replaced by guessing
example: Says dig for pick beside: p, i, ck blended
if_many: Cover the picture; touch each letter, say its sound, then blend.

error: A passage is read word by word, with no phrasing and no end marks.
shows: The reading does not sound like talking
example: Reads each word at the same pitch with a stop between, beside: reading in phrases
if_many: Echo one line, then read it together, voice going up at the question and down at the full stop.

error: A misread word that breaks the sense is left, even after the prompt.
shows: The meaning is not checked after decoding
example: Leaves yanks as yaks, beside: Dot yanks it
if_many: Read the sentence again; stop at the word that does not fit; look at its letters and fix it.

error: A vowel in a word is read with the wrong sound, short for long or long for short.
shows: Short and long vowel sounds are mixed
example: Reads chest as cheest, beside: a short e
if_many: Two word cards in a line; say which vowel is long and which is short; read each.

error: The ending of a word is dropped or changed when it is read.
shows: The ending is not read
example: Reads yanked as yank, beside: yank, then the ending
if_many: Cover the ending, read the base, uncover and add the ending.

error: A mapped word is sounded out as if it were regular, or guessed.
shows: The part to remember is not remembered
example: Sounds said as sayd, beside: said
if_many: Tap each sound, then say the word whole and mark the part to remember.

error: Vowel length is judged by the length of the word or its first letter, not by its sound.
shows: The vowel sound is not heard
example: Holds the short card for cake because it has four letters, beside: long a
if_many: Say the word slowly and stretch the vowel; hold the card for the stretched sound.

error: A sound is dropped or added when words are blended or taken apart.
shows: Not every sound is held
example: Says bim for blimp, beside: b, l, i, m, p
if_many: Five counters in a row; push one for each sound and say the word.

error: The first sound is given where the middle or last is asked.
shows: The position of a sound is not tracked
example: Says d for the middle of drum, beside: u
if_many: Three boxes in a row; the sound goes in the box the teacher names.

error: A word is spelled by letter names, or a sound is left out.
shows: A spelling does not follow each sound
example: Writes plg for plug, beside: p, l, u, g
if_many: Say the word slowly; one counter for each sound, then write a letter for each.

error: A mapped word is spelled as it sounds.
shows: The part to remember is not remembered
example: Writes dis for this, beside: th, i, s
if_many: Show the word card, cover it, and write it; mark the part to remember.

error: A detail is named as the key idea, or another detail is given for the one asked.
shows: The topic and its details are not told apart
example: Says the blades for the topic, beside: shears
if_many: Two cards, a whole picture and a part; the child points to what the whole text is about.

error: An answer comes from the child own life, or from nothing the text says.
shows: The text heard is replaced by what the child knows
example: My bicycle is blue, beside: the squeak made Tavi cross
if_many: Hear the text again and point to the picture that answers the question.

error: Who tells or speaks is mixed up, or a picture fact is taken for a word fact.
shows: The teller, or the source of a fact, is not told apart
example: Says Uncle Anan tells page 1, beside: Tavi tells page 1
if_many: Mark the speech marks; the words inside them belong to the one who speaks.

error: Events are told out of order or stop at one.
shows: The order of events is not held
example: Says the squeak is gone, then the tin, beside: first the squeak, then the tin
if_many: Three picture cards in a mix; the child lays them in order and says each.

error: A piece of writing gives no closing, or gives an opinion where facts are asked.
shows: The parts of the piece are not all there
example: Tongs are the best, beside: tongs lift corn and keep hands cool
if_many: Three boxes: the tool, two facts, a last line; say each aloud, then fill it.

error: A named book part is not found, or another book part is pointed to.
shows: The book parts are not told apart
example: Points to the contents for the glossary, beside: the box with the word and its meaning
if_many: Four cards, one for each book part; the teacher names a job and the child holds the matching card.

error: A long vowel spelling is read with a short vowel, or the reverse.
shows: The long vowel spelling is not read
example: Reads sheep as shep, beside: ee says one long sound
if_many: Two word cards, one short and one long; underline the vowel team and say its sound.

error: An ending is added without the base changing, or a base changes when it should not.
shows: The ending rule is not held
example: Reads raced as racked, beside: race, then -ed
if_many: Base card and ending card side by side; slide the e away and read.

error: A two-syllable word is read for its first part only.
shows: The second part is not read
example: Reads napkin as nap, beside: nap and kin
if_many: Clap the parts, cover one, read each, then say the whole word.

error: A word part is given the wrong meaning, or no meaning.
shows: The word part is not used
example: Says un- means again, beside: un- means not
if_many: Two word cards, lock and unlock; the child says which one is not locked.

error: A reason for an opinion is missing, or does not tell why.
shows: The opinion has no reason
example: Says a spade is best, with no why, beside: because it digs deep
if_many: Sentence frame: I think ___ because ___; the child says the because part.
